qualifier: retinal neuron differentiation, lens and ocular vasculature
name: Eye development including retinal neurons, lens and vasculature
rationale: Nearly all members concern morphogenesis, differentiation or maintenance of eye tissues (retina, photoreceptors, lens, cornea, iris, retinal vessels and blood-retinal barrier); unlike the closest confusable it lacks phototransduction and retinoid metabolism, and unlike the others it lacks inner-ear development.

qualifier: leptin signaling and body growth
name: Leptin-regulated appetite, feeding behavior and body growth
rationale: Members regulate eating, response to food/nutrient levels and organism growth, including leptin and ghrelin signaling, whereas confusables are growth hormone or gut-peptide/cAMP GPCR signaling without leptin.

qualifier: vascular tone and vasoconstriction
name: Renin-angiotensin control of vascular tone and blood pressure
rationale: Members concern angiotensin signaling and systemic/pulmonary arterial pressure control including vasoconstriction, while confusables emphasize renal sodium/urine handling and angiotensinogen processing.

qualifier: adhesion disassembly and invadopodia
name: Cell-substrate adhesion turnover and invadopodia in migration
rationale: Members cover integrin/syndecan adhesion, cell spreading, stress fibers and substrate-dependent migration, and uniquely include focal adhesion disassembly, junction downregulation and invadopodia, whereas confusables center on MET-PTK2, fibronectin matrix and fibroblast/ECM programs.

core: RIG-I/MDA5 antiviral signaling to type I interferon
qualifier: TRAF3/TRAF6 relay and viral antagonism
name: RIG-I/MDA5-TRAF signaling to interferon and viral antagonism
rationale: Members are cytosolic RNA sensing by RIG-I-like receptors relayed via TRAF3/TRAF6 to IRF and NF-kB and interferon-alpha/beta production, including its modulation by SARS-CoV and RSV, while confusables emphasize IRF3, dsRNA, ZBP1 and cytosolic DNA sensing.

qualifier: heme, iron-sulfur cluster and quinone
name: Mitochondrial heme, iron-sulfur cluster and quinone biosynthesis
rationale: Members are biosynthesis of heme/tetrapyrroles, Fe-S clusters and ubiquinol plus Fe-S/ferredoxin-dependent processes (TCA enzyme maturation, pregnenolone synthesis), distinguishing it from erythrocyte gas transport, iron uptake and respiratory chain assembly confusables.

qualifier: meiosis, gonad development, fertilization and zygotic activation
name: Germ cell meiosis, gonad development, fertilization and zygotic activation
rationale: Members span gonad and germ cell development, gonadotropin/sex-hormone control, meiotic recombination and segregation, sperm-oocyte interaction, germline transposon silencing and the maternal-to-zygotic transition, whereas confusables are mitotic cell cycle or placental/reproductive-tract development.

qualifier: replication origin licensing and initiation
name: E2F-driven G1/S origin licensing and DNA replication initiation
rationale: Members are E2F target programs and pre-replicative complex assembly/activation (ORC, CDC6), replication initiation and replication-stress checkpoint, while confusables add E2F6 and G2/M transition without origin licensing.

qualifier: superoxide generation by NADPH oxidase
name: Phagocyte respiratory burst and superoxide generation
rationale: Members center on regulation of the NADPH oxidase respiratory burst and superoxide production in neutrophils and macrophages, whereas confusables focus on bacterial/fungal killing, degranulation and inflammatory signaling.

qualifier: serotonin and histamine synthesis and transport
name: Serotonin and histamine synthesis, transport and receptor signaling
rationale: All members concern serotonin or histamine biosynthesis, metabolism, uptake/secretion and their receptors, while confusables are muscarinic acetylcholine and tachykinin receptor signaling.

qualifier: NMDA/AMPA receptor activation and proximal signaling
name: NMDA and AMPA receptor activation and proximal signaling
rationale: Members are glutamate receptor gating, surface assembly and immediate downstream Ras/RAC1 signaling in LTP, while confusables emphasize CaMK-CREB nuclear signaling, memory and dendritic spine structural plasticity.

qualifier: AP-site repair synthesis and OGG1/MUTYH defects
name: Base excision repair synthesis and OGG1/MUTYH glycosylase defects
rationale: Members are post-incision BER steps (AP-site processing, short/long-patch gap filling) and defective OGG1/MUTYH processing of oxidized guanine lesions, whereas confusables cover damaged-base recognition and cleavage, NTHL1/NEIL defects or mitochondrial DNA repair.

qualifier: NK and CD8 T cell effector activation
name: Activation of NK and CD8 T cell cytotoxicity
rationale: Members are NK and T cell signatures with positive regulation of NK/T cell cytotoxicity, degranulation and CD8 T cell proliferation, while confusables emphasize KIR/inhibitory receptors, MHC class Ib presentation and tolerance.

qualifier: metaphase alignment and anaphase transition control
name: Meiotic metaphase chromosome alignment and anaphase transition control
rationale: All members concern aligning and segregating meiotic chromosomes and restraining the metaphase-anaphase transition, unlike confusables on recombination/synapsis, cohesion, G2/MI entry or oocyte spindle positioning.

qualifier: 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases and branched-chain amino acid breakdown
name: Mitochondrial acyl-CoA catabolism via 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases and BCAA breakdown
rationale: Members are mitochondrial acyl-CoA-producing pathways (PDH/OGDH/BCKDH/OADH, BCAA and lysine catabolism, beta-oxidation, ketone bodies) with their cofactors and inborn errors, while confusables are carnitine-dependent fatty acid transport or malate-aspartate/carboxylate transport.

qualifier: kynurenine route to de novo NAD+
name: Tryptophan catabolism via kynurenine to de novo NAD+
rationale: All members describe tryptophan breakdown through kynurenine and quinolinate to NAD+, unlike confusables on NAD salvage, threonine/glycine, aromatic or histidine amino acid catabolism.

qualifier: distal cholesterol synthesis and inherited CYP/transporter defects
name: Distal cholesterol biosynthesis and inherited CYP and transporter defects
rationale: Members are post-lanosterol Bloch/Kandutsch-Russell cholesterol synthesis plus inherited defects of small-molecule-metabolizing CYPs and transporters (CYP7B1, CYP1B1, CYP26C1, TBXAS1, SLCO2A1, ABCB6), whereas confusables cover bile acid synthesis/CTX or the early mevalonate pathway.

qualifier: 2-oxoglutarate/2-oxoadipate dehydrogenase and glycine cleavage
name: Lipoylated 2-oxoglutarate/2-oxoadipate dehydrogenase and glycine cleavage complexes
rationale: Members are protein lipoylation and the lipoylated, DLD-sharing OGDH, OADH and glycine cleavage complexes, distinct from confusables centered on BCKDH/PDH, GABA/lysine metabolism or the wider TCA cycle.

qualifier: non-histone targets such as p53
name: Non-histone lysine mono- and dimethylation, including p53
rationale: All members concern lysine mono/dimethylation of proteins, including p53 regulation, whereas confusables address histone lysine methylation complexes, DNA methylation or acetylation.

qualifier: core transcription and translation cycle
name: Mitochondrial transcription and translation initiation, elongation, termination
rationale: Members are the initiation, elongation and termination steps of mitochondrial transcription and translation plus ribosome quality control, whereas confusables cover mtDNA replication, RNA processing/modification, ribosome assembly or tRNA charging.

qualifier: post-Golgi export and endosome membrane tubulation
name: Post-Golgi and endosomal transport with endosome membrane tubulation
rationale: Members are Golgi vesicle budding, constitutive secretion, Golgi-to-endosome and endosomal transport with membrane tubulation and receptor recycling, while confusables center on COPI/Golgi-ER retrograde traffic, Golgi organization and lysosomal targeting.

qualifier: T cell lineage, thymocytes and TCR costimulation
name: T cell-dominated lymphocyte differentiation and TCR activation
rationale: Members are thymocyte and T cell differentiation (CD8, gamma-delta, ITK/PKC) and TCR activation modules with some B cell development, whereas confusables are B cell, germinal center or IL2/IL7-centered programs.

qualifier: electron transport and chemiosmotic ATP synthesis
name: Respiratory electron transport and chemiosmotic ATP synthesis
rationale: Members are the mitochondrial electron transport chain (ubiquinol to oxygen) and chemiosmotic ATP formation, whereas confusables concern assembly of respiratory complexes and mitochondrial translation.

qualifier: isocitrate/2-oxoglutarate with NADPH regeneration
name: Isocitrate, 2-oxoglutarate and malate metabolism with NADPH regeneration
rationale: Members are TCA intermediates isocitrate, 2-oxoglutarate and malate, their NADPH-generating dehydrogenation and aberrant 2-hydroxyglutarate formation, unlike confusables on lipoylated dehydrogenase complexes, succinate/ETC, malate-aspartate shuttle or PDH.

qualifier: cytosolic and mitochondrial, with wobble modification
name: tRNA aminoacylation and wobble modification for translational fidelity
rationale: Members are cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA charging and wobble-position tRNA modifications supporting decoding fidelity, while confusables concern mitochondrial translation, RNA processing or tRNA methylation/pseudouridylation.
